about: Dependencies a maintainer reviewed and accepted although scripts/license-check.mjs flags their license. Each entry: {"name": "<npm package>", "license": "<exact license string the check reports>", "reason": "<why it is acceptable>"}. See haxtheweb/issues#3262.
